children: This is the wave structure subpage for Easy Mode. It contains its every past wave layout.
These are the current and former wave layouts for
names indicates an enemy type's debut.
Zombies are on their way. Prepare to defend!
Make sure to place down some units near the path and upgrade them. Together, we've got this.
Alright! There are some Speedy enemies coming. They're fast, but weak.
You might need some more units to help defend if one slips by, so make sure your towers have enough path coverage to deal with them.
Up ahead are some Large Zombies. They're slow but have a lot of health.
You can command some of your towers to prioritize stronger targets, but make sure to keep a few focused on the weaker ones otherwise they might get by.
Heads up! You have a Boss Zombie coming! They can have special attributes that make them resistant to certain attacks.
Professor V has given us the technology that lets us see their stats and modifiers if you select them.
Also, we might have some Hidden enemies soon. Only some units can see them, so be sure to upgrade the ones that do.
There they are! Man, Hidden zombies are tough to see.
Here comes some Breakers! They can spawn additional weaker enemies. Too many at once could overwhelm your units if you're not careful.
Seems like the corpses attracted a Necromancer. They will raise the dead to make them... uh... less dead?
You might want to try prioritizing them here.
You're doing great, keep it up! Those armored enemies are tougher to deal with, but I'm sure you've got enough upgrades to deal with them
Woah! Did you feel the ground shake? Something big is coming!
We're not out of this yet, so don't get comfortable!
It's those fast zombies again! Slowing units like Freezer can give our team more time to take them down.
All that fighting attracted the Brute!
Let's give it all we got!

Let's send this Brute back to where it came from!
